New Mexico: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open New Mexico on the map

Key dates

  • Last day to register online or by mail: October 6, 2026. After this date you can still register and vote on the same day at your county clerk's office, at early voting sites, or at your polling place on Election Day.
  • Early in-person voting: October 6, 2026 to October 31, 2026. Early voting starts October 6 at county clerk offices. On October 17 it opens at more locations in each county. It ends Saturday, October 31.
  • Last day to request an absentee ballot: October 20, 2026. Your county clerk must receive your completed absentee ballot by 7:00 p.m. on Election Day. You can also drop it off at a voting location or an official drop box.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are open 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. You can register and vote on the same day at your polling place.

Official election information: vote.gov

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.

State

Governor and Lieutenant Governor

This is an open seat with a four-year term, because Gov. Michelle Lujan Grisham cannot run again due to term limits. Governor and lieutenant governor run together on one ticket: Gregg Hull with running mate David M. Gallegos (Republican), and Deb Haaland with running mate Stephanie Garcia Richard (Democratic).
